environment.description: Same application container image deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALBv2. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule group 'app-input-validation' with a RegexPatternSet match on query string values matching pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|sleep\s*\(|benchmark\s*\()` with BLOCK action and priority 50, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default action. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress policy (tasks can reach internet), and CloudWatch logging is enabled on the WAF with sampled requests visible.

config.load_balancer: ALBv2 with HTTPS listener, target group health check on /health
config.waf_rule_priority_50: Custom rule group 'app-input-validation': RegexPatternSet on QueryString values, pattern: (?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|sleep\s*\(|benchmark\s*\()
config.network: private subnet, NAT gateway for egress, no direct inbound
